sources.label: Patches for use with Morphe by 0x11DFE
sources.author: 0x11DFE
patch_list: Empties com.pairip.licensecheck.LicenseClient.checkLicense so PairIP does not kill the re-signed APK. Works on any app that ships this class.
Skips the paywall after the tutorial: it runs the app's own free-choice handler (completeOnboarding, then home) and renders nothing. Fails cleanly when the bundle changes.
Unlocks Waypoint Pro. The getCustomerInfo bridge and the hybridcommon mapper report a fake active lifetime entitlement (waypoint_lifetime), so it works even when api.revenuecat.com is unreachable.
